decisions.reason: Moving the I2C pull-ups to the main board does not change the battery connector's NTC-contact requirement.
The I2C pull-up relocation does not affect battery overcharge, overdischarge, or thermal-protection behavior.
Relocating I2C pull-ups between existing boards leaves the established three-board architecture unchanged.
The I2C pull-up relocation is unrelated to TVS ESD protection on the power board.
The source concerns I2C pull-up resistors, not the MT3608 enable pull-down or software-switched 5V rail behavior.
